title: KB document schema
content:
KB documents are stored as text with metadata and indexed by vector search. Required fields:

- doc_id (stable string)
- doc_type (skill|process|knowledge)
- title
- content
- tags (string list)
- source
- created_at / updated_at

This repo uses Qdrant locally and a deterministic hash-based embedding stub so it runs without external API keys.
